fallback.name: combo
fallback.description: Fallback router for cross-workflow or uncertain substantive requests, or explicit $combo invocation.

entries.name: combo-deliver
entries.description: Implement software features, behavior changes, or refactors through verification. Use when the user wants working code, including requests to plan and build together; tiny understood edits can stay inline.

entries.name: combo-debug
entries.description: Diagnose and repair software failures, regressions, build errors, or slowness using evidence and focused verification. Honor diagnosis-only requests without making repairs.

entries.name: combo-plan
entries.description: Develop software requirements, architecture decisions, or implementation plans from the actual code and constraints. Use for plan-only work; a request to build as well continues through delivery.

entries.name: combo-review
entries.description: Review code or changes for requirement fidelity and implementation risks.

entries.name: combo-verify
entries.description: Run software tests, validate builds, or exercise a product user journey and report observed results. Use for verification requests, with native browser tools when the check needs a UI.

entries.name: combo-investigate
entries.description: Trace code or compare technical options without changing the repository.

entries.name: combo-research
entries.description: Research scientific literature, markets, competitors, or substantive evidence questions. Evaluate sources and support the requested explanation or decision; simple factual answers can stay inline.

entries.name: combo-content
entries.description: Write articles, brand copy, outreach drafts, or campaigns; derive voice from samples and repurpose material across social, email, and video formats. Use native tools for document and design artifacts.

entries.name: combo-learning
entries.description: Teach concepts and skills, design exercises, or create lessons and courses for the learner's goals. Use worked examples and retrieval practice at the requested depth; brief definitions can stay inline.

entries.name: combo-business
entries.description: Analyze business strategy, finance, inventory, demand, logistics, procurement, or production operations using the user's data and constraints. Produce traceable calculations, plans, or authorized operational updates.

entries.name: combo-media
entries.description: Develop visual direction, motion, video edits, or multimedia production using source assets and the requested story. Pair domain techniques with the native image, design, presentation, and video tools.

entries.name: combo-productivity
entries.description: Organize work, triage backlogs, prepare handoffs or questionnaires, and improve agent-facing instructions. Use the existing workspace and trackers, with native host tools for task management and scheduling.
